title: Install verified skills for a selected supported target
description: Project users can inspect an installation plan, acquire a trusted compatible skill archive, and install or explicitly replace its complete target units while preserving unrelated work. They receive honest conflict, safety, and partial-effect information; installation does not adopt governance or manage project state.

includes: Supported target selection, trusted network or local archive acquisition, and integrity verification.
Nonmutating preliminary plans, complete destination conflict checks, and explicitly authorized whole-unit replacement.
Path/concurrency protection, retained originals, safe diagnostics, and bounded failure/retry outcomes.
excludes: Automatic managed upgrades, project-state creation or migration, and cleanup of unrelated or retired installed skills.
Inferring replacement or workflow authority from package validity or installation.
Making the CLI a prerequisite for individual portable skill use.

sources.basis: IR-010 establishes this stakeholder-visible published-product capability. This draft models existing selected obligations, not observed publication or installation success.
